Since this is a vulnerable tenant who prefers email but there's no portal channel option, I'll send the reply via his email on file rather than the chat channel, noting the Swift plumbing and heating visit already logged in the system.

The bin issue falls outside our remit—that's a council (Tower Hamlets) matter, so I won't invent dates or raise a ticket for it. I should also ask whether his heating and hot water are currently working given his vulnerable status, and tell him to flag it immediately if it's gone down.

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal chat. Boiler job (R-4799): the engineer has visited and quoted for replacing a part called an expansion vessel, which is the likely cause of the pressure drops. Your landlord has asked for a second quote before deciding, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 October. Once we have that quote, we'll send both to your landlord for a decision. I can't give a repair date yet as it isn't approved. Until then, please keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water, tell us straight away and we'll treat it as urgent. Bins: we don't handle collections. Please check or report a missed collection on the Tower Hamlets council website. I haven't got a date for you. Sorry for the wait.
